## What changed

Describe the user-visible or protocol behavior and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant unit and integration tests pass.
- [ ] Contract changes include fuzz/invariant regression coverage.
- [ ] New dependency is necessary, exactly locked, and security-reviewed.
- [ ] Wallet signatures/transactions and failure states are understandable.
- [ ] Value-moving change has an independent reviewer and Safe simulation.

## Documentation and disclosure

- [ ] README and linked documentation reflect changes to scope, setup, public behavior, rules, schemas, addresses, or releases.
- [ ] No secret, private key, credential, personal data, non-public partner term, signer detail, or private infrastructure identifier is present.
- [ ] Public claims describe implemented or explicitly planned behavior without implying an unaudited deployment is live.

## Risk and rollback

State affected assets, roles, data, deployment steps, monitoring, and rollback or
pause procedure. Write `none` only with an explanation.
